text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I've had a headache since this morning. 
Maybe my body's been under more strain 
than I realized..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I saw somewhere that headaches 
are caused by irregular lifestyle habits, 
but my exercise and sleep schedules have 
been totally normal.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, could it be a nutritional 
imbalance? Um, what have I eaten over the 
past few days...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... trying to remember just made the 
pain worse... I suppose it's a case of 
'the carrot or the appetite' first...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while, Sakura Chiyono O was troubled 
by headaches of an unknown cause.
